versions.changelog:
AI Friendly Architecture Design v2.0.0

- Added detailed guidance on Model Management, including provider selection, failover strategy, and cost optimization.
- Expanded documentation to clarify the responsibilities and boundaries of the Session Layer.
- Improved references and context by restructuring evaluation/test documents, removing outdated files and adding new resources.
- Clarified taxonomy and pattern sourcing for Agent types; included external references for ReAct.
- Refined explanations across architecture layers and coordination patterns.
- Updated licensing information and improved quick-reference sections.

ai-friendly-architecture-design v1.0.0

- Initial release providing an architectural guide for building AI-friendly systems.
- Outlines three paradigm shifts: deterministic→probabilistic, structured→semantic, static→dynamic.
- Introduces architecture layers, agent types, intent/session layers, and multi-agent coordination patterns.
- Provides best practices for AI-friendly API design and context engineering.
- Includes a decision framework and highlights common mistakes to avoid.
